content: In Figure FIGREF23 , we show the change of accuracy with respect to the percentage of unlabeled data used for training on three particular problems under setting 1. The value at INLINEFORM0 denotes the accuracies of NaiveNN which does not utilize any target data. For DAS, we observe a nonlinear increasing trend where the accuracy quickly improves at the beginning, and then gradually stabilizes. For other methods, this trend is less obvious, and adding more unlabeled data sometimes even worsen the results. This finding again suggests that the proposed approach can better exploit the information from unlabeled data.
